question: Do all native LAIH and DALMUT sample owners support literal Betula29/Ulmus310 count aggregation on the same six calibrated-BP windows already used by the Nordic coupled consumer, rather than only an incomplete whole-core panel?
scientific_consumer: Resolve a concrete common-axis/window source prerequisite for a possible Swedish-only versus four-country LRA comparison. This is source accounting, not a new LRA comparison or admission.
source_identity_basis: Authenticate original retained April2026 download parts against the existing relational-baseline raw_archive pins and raw-manifest dataset membership. Reuse exact retained bytes; no HTTP capture, census rerun or whole-Neotoma capture-identity claim.

cores.physical_limit: The released 285m/25.5ha modern site statement and restricted R marker do not admit historical basin, exact LandClim ages, PPE/covariance or analytical rights.
The 7.2ha primary and 8ha/160m workbook statements remain separate; no historical shoreline, original LandClim-selected age vector or parameter/use-rights admission.

chronology_policy: Select only the explicit per-core unique calibrated point chronology, exact native ID/name/type; preserve every original claim/declaration and both literal isdefault flags. Never substitute the collection reference or use publication/preparation year as BP origin. These source-point chronologies are not authenticated historical LandClim input vectors or age-uncertainty laws.
bound_policy: A finite selected point may have absent or null younger/older bounds. Preserve original missing keys versus null values and all raw age claims; any present nonnull bound must be finite and contain the point. Missing bounds do not yield a confidence interval, interpolation, calibration or a distribution. Missing/duplicate/wrong-type/invalid/conflicting point claims remain unassignable.
owner_and_window_policy: Account for every unique native owner in original order:150LAIH+72DALMUT. Retain source sample/analysis-unit IDs, depth/thickness, all ages, literal axis evidence and every datum classification. Half-open fixed windows; negative/outside ages remain distinct. Any unassignable selected-age owner suppresses all six aggregates of its own core only. Do not pool cores or silently select complete-count samples within a window.
aggregate_policy: Every one of twelve requested core/windows remains with ordered native member IDs, status, panel/full NISP/excluded mass if defined. Explicit empty, incomplete panel, zero panel, invalid full mass and unassignable-age statuses; absent Ulmus is never reported zero. Whole-core counts and known-valid reported-cell subtotals remain separate from complete denominators and do not replace window support.
rights_and_attribution: Preserve retained Neotoma/EPD source ownership, exact per-core native dataset/contact metadata and citations; local curation of already retained source only. Source availability, source-point compatibility and aggregate support grant no new analytical/redistribution permission or qualified scientific review. Detailed native/count products remain local artifacts; commit no raw source table.
scope: Source precondition accounting for two named cores only. No reconstruction, inverse fit, kernel, prediction, scoring, new observed outcome, bootstrap, source acquisition, country reassignment, historical-input equivalence, physical/core/PPE/field admission or claim of four-country completion.
